newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products firm, fuel oil barges gain $3.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products firm, fuel oil barges gain $3.

text.p: NWE oil products firmed again on Tuesday, notably fuel oil barges which rose around $3 a tonne, dealers said.
High sulphur fuel oil barges strengthened as one major bought at $85, $86 and, possibly, $87 fob Rotterdam even though there was no improvement in bunker demand from Monday's poor levels.
Heating oil barges were about $1 a tonne higher as IPE gas oil futures gained. Demand remained poor.
